collection.title: Mini Coupe 2012 to 2026 windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: All of the following wiper blades will fit a Mino Coupe 2012 Onwards model which requires a 20" wiper blade on both the drivers side and the passengers side. This model uses the Pinch Tab arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm.

image.alt: Mini Coupe 2012 to 2024 Windscreen Wiper Blades
